d:
Two Special Police Officers (SPOs) have been reported missing after firing was heard in the Deharna forest area of Marwah in Jammu and Kashmir's Kishtwar district. According to initial information, the two personnel, identified as Rishipal and Bobby Chand, were part of the Special Operations Group (SOG). They were travelling from Kiyar Dachhan to relieve a team of the Army's 17 Rashtriya Rifles deployed at Basnan in the Inderwan area of Upper Ridge Deharna.
